subject: Issue with Shiny and Corporate Internet Settings

messages.author: d4a7bd075fee023e
messages.subject: Issue with Shiny and Corporate Internet Settings
parts:
Hi, we run a number of shiny apps that help our readers look up fantasy football stats. We have a few thousand subscribers and rarely get complaints about the apps loading. But every once in awhile readers will report that when they're at work (presumably behind corporate internet configurations) the apps will timeout and never load.

Here's an error message that someone sent me from Chrome.

Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT http://198.58.103.208:3838/nflSplits/

Has anyone seen this before and are you aware of anything we can do on our end to fix this? Or is this something that the end user would have to change (which is unlikely because no one wants to go to their IT department and say that they're doing fantasy football research at work).

Thanks for any help you can provide.

messages.author: 8a98edc55c6202fc
messages.subject: Re: Issue with Shiny and Corporate Internet Settings
parts:
The problem is that they probably block port 3838 that shiny is running on. So you need to proxy to port 80 with apache. You will need the newest version of shiny server. Read here: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!starred/shiny-discuss/XQQQbN0EH-o
Then setup apache like this: https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/JUzPpRmkHsA/Fx0eR1ogYWkJ


- Jan
